entities.summary: Jean-Louis Anne Madelain Lefebvre de Cheverus was a French-born Catholic prelate who served as the first bishop of Boston. He later served as bishop of Montauban and archbishop of Bordeaux, both in France. He was elevated to the cardinalate in 1836.
